name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.13.1: the downloads page now derives the current build from the OTA release registry instead of relying entirely on a hand-maintained list. The release record already holds the version name, version code, APK path, size and publish time for each app, so keeping a separate downloads list duplicated those facts and let the two drift — the page could advertise a different build than the one being rolled out, which on a sideload-only machine costs a site visit. Current coil and fridge releases are merged into the page automatically, resolved against the serving origin like the OTA manifest; a manual entry with the same version code still wins, so curated notes or an external URL are preserved. Cumulative over v6.13.
